Deep Laceration: Apply direct pressure with a clean cloth. If bleeding bleeds through, add more cloth on top, do not remove the base layer. Elevate the limb above the heart. Do not use a tourniquet unless bleeding is life-threatening and cannot be controlled with pressure.
Sprain: Follow RICE: Rest, Ice, Compression, Elevation. Immobilize the joint. Do not apply heat for the first 48 hours.
